show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/fbnGbT
show.description: A chance meeting at a railway station brings together Aryan, a humble porter, and Aarohi, the daughter of a powerful diamond tycoon. When Aarohi chooses love over wealth and society, Aryan is humiliated, tested, and pushed to his limits. As secrets unravel, the world discovers that true worth is not defined by status or money but by courage, integrity, and love. This is a romantic drama where a “coolie” becomes a king, and love proves to be the rarest diamond of all.
